mentions.name: Coagent
mentions.description: This AI agent for real estate agents lets users manage their CRM with voice/chat, provides personalized property feeds based on what prospects and clients actually like, automatically routes field work such as pop-by visits, and automates showings with shareable itineraries and map tracking of both the agent and the client, including adding coffee stops.
mentions.source_excerpt: primarily, an agent for real estate agents that lets you manage your CRM with voice/chat, personalized property feeds based on what prospects/clients actually like, automatic routing for setting up pop-by visits or other field work, and showings automations that let you share a showings itinerary, and track both the agent and the client on a map, add coffee stops, and more: https://getcoagent.ai/
mentions.author: darvid
